page.overview:
Who is Wensley?

Wensley is a background Earth pony and a member of the Apple family. He has a green coat, a bright yellow mane, dark red eyes, and a cutie mark of two apples and a block of cheese. He is unnamed in the show, but he is named in merchandise and other media.__TOC__

Wensley shares his design and mane color with S04E26 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, shares his design with Caramel, Golden Delicious, Cherry Fizzy, Royal Riff, "Black Stone", "Strawberry Cream", S01E02 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, "Cormano", "Gingerbread", BeauDe Mane, "Neon Brush", Upper East Stride, S04E22 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, S04E22 Unnamed Earth Stallion #2, S04E24 Unnamed Earth Stallion #4, S04E24 Unnamed Earth Stallion #6, and sometimes "Sir Pony Moore", and shares his mane and style with Ace Point, Doctor Horse, "Black Marble", "Medallion Gold", S04E12 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #2, S04E22 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #2, Warm Front, "Dewdrop", "Sunlight", "Cloud Break", "Serenity", "High Note", Starburst, "Silverwing", S04E22 Unnamed Earth Stallion #9, and sometimes "Star Bright".

In Filli Vanilli, Wensley appears as a spectator of the Ponyville turkey call competition. He later appears walking toward Flim and Flam's tent at the beginning of Leap of Faith and having his own trading stall at the Rainbow Falls Traders Exchange in Trade Ya!

In The Maud Couple, Wensley appears in Ponyville walking past all the "Missing Maud" flyers.
